Rest areas on a regular month
The aim of this section is to explain what is expected

Companion Animal Travel Desk - Rest Area and Booking Control

This section sets the standard for safe handling of companion animal travel requests. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and staff shall keep their tone calm, clear, and professional at all times. The desk shall record each request with care, verify the traveler details, and confirm that the animal is fit for travel before any service commitment is made. <<FACT F085>> No staff member shall promise acceptance before the review is complete, and no exception may be made for convenience.

All requests shall be checked for completeness before processing continues. <<FACT F091>> Staff shall examine supporting information, watch for signs of distress, and refer any doubtful case to the senior coordinator without delay. If a traveler raises a concern, the answer shall be direct and courteous, with no speculation and no casual reassurance that could weaken safety judgment. The cabin team monitors animals during flight, and the desk shall ensure that the traveler understands this shared responsibility before departure.

Records shall be kept accurate, legible, and available for audit. Any missed detail, conflicting instruction, or condition that may affect welfare shall be corrected at once through the proper channel. The desk shall not rely on verbal memory alone when the matter affects boarding, supervision, or recovery after landing. If a pet is named in the booking file, staff shall use that name consistently in internal communication and shall avoid unnecessary repetition in passenger-facing notices.

Report unresolved concerns to the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways, Companion Animal Travel Desk.
